framework: 10-question pitch intake + AI follow-up gap review + 10-slide deck generation

questions.text: Tell me about one real person whose life is directly affected by the problem you're solving.
questions.hint: Give them a name. Paint their situation. Make the struggle vivid and human — this will become the emotional heart of your pitch.

questions.text: What problem are you tackling — and what are its root causes?
questions.hint: Be specific. What's broken? Who created this situation? Why hasn't it been fixed yet?

questions.text: How big is this problem? Give me the numbers — statistics, data, key figures that show its urgency.
questions.hint: Think: how many people are affected? What's the economic or social cost? Any shocking facts that show why this can't wait?

questions.text: What exactly are you doing about this problem — and how does it work in practice?
questions.hint: Walk me through it step by step. What makes your approach different from what's been tried before?

questions.text: Why are you and your team the right people to solve this problem?
questions.hint: What's your background, lived experience, expertise? What's your personal connection to this issue? Why now?

questions.text: What have you already achieved? Any pilots, partnerships, people reached, early results?
questions.hint: Even small wins matter. Tell me what exists today — proof that this isn't just an idea, it's already working.

questions.text: How do you measure your social impact? What changes in people's lives because of your work?
questions.hint: Think outcomes, not outputs. Not 'we trained 200 people' but 'those people then…' What's the chain of change?

questions.text: How does your organisation sustain itself and grow? What are your revenue streams, and how will you scale?
questions.hint: Are you grant-funded, fee-for-service, earned income, hybrid? How do you move from pilot to systemic scale?

questions.text: How much investment are you seeking — and what exactly will you spend it on?
questions.hint: Break it down: what buckets of spending? Over what period? What does the money unlock?

questions.text: What's in it for investors? What financial return and social return will their money generate?
questions.hint: Be honest about both dimensions. Timeline to financial sustainability? Social ROI per dollar? Your growth trajectory?
